properties.statement:
THE LAUNCH WRAPPER WHOSE ENTIRE PURPOSE IS "NEVER SERVE A STALE BINARY" IS BLIND TO THE SCHEMA. tools/reflow2-mcp-launch.sh:31-36 content-hashes `crates/**/src/*.rs` plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/crates/*/Cargo.toml — and nothing else. The schema YAML is compiled into the binary with include_str! (crates/reflow2-core/src/schema.rs:19-38), so a schema-only change leaves the hash UNCHANGED, the wrapper prints "binary current, skipping build", and the server serves the previous vocabulary.

MEASURED 2026-08-15, and it cost a wrong write that was caught only by chance: main already carried #199's `change_type: defect_fix` and the new `subject` axis in schema/temporal.yaml, but describe_schema on the running server returned the enum WITHOUT them. The value about to be recorded was the exact fiction #199 had been merged hours earlier to end. It was noticed only because the on-disk YAML was grepped and compared against what the tool reported — nothing in the tool's own answer says which build it came from.

WHY IT IS WORSE THAN AN ORDINARY STALE BINARY: the wrapper's comment (lines 10-15) explains it hashes CONTENT precisely because cargo's mtime check is untrustworthy after a git operation — so it is a deliberate, reasoned guard that was simply pointed at the wrong file set. A session therefore gets a CONFIDENT "binary current" for the one class of change where being wrong silently corrupts the vocabulary the design is written in. `tests/**` is outside the hash too, which matters less.

NOT FIXED HERE, and deliberately: it is a separate defect from the one this branch settles, and widening the change to include it was not asked for. The fix is one line — add schema/*.yaml to the srchash — and until it lands, a schema change on this repo requires a manual `cargo build -p reflow2-mcp` plus `--stop-shared` before the new vocabulary is served. IT DOES NOT AFFECT CONSUMERS: they run an installed release binary, not this wrapper.
properties.value: {"file":"tools/reflow2-mcp-launch.sh:31-36","hashes":["crates/**/src/*.rs","Cargo.toml","Cargo.lock","crates/*/Cargo.toml"],"omits":["schema/*.yaml","crates/**/tests/*.rs"],"mechanism":"schema is include_str! into the binary (crates/reflow2-core/src/schema.rs:19-38)","observed":"describe_schema on the running server returned the pre-#199 change_type enum while main's schema/temporal.yaml already declared defect_fix and subject","near_miss":"the ChangeEvent for this very branch was about to be recorded as test_failure_fix, the fiction #199 exists to end","workaround":"cargo build -p reflow2-mcp, then reflow2-mcp --graph-path <path> --stop-shared","blast_radius":"this repo only - consumers run an installed release binary","fix":"add schema/*.yaml to srchash()"}
